abstract: Maintains protected ecosystem clearance and wilderness preservation permits
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance officer (ENVR), responsible for maintaining protected ecosystem clearance and wilderness preservation permits across candidate field expedition camps.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains protected ecosystem clearance and wilderness preservation permits（ECOPERM）
information_points.content:
ENVR-ECOPERM-L16：For Atacama Plateau Base, environmental impact clearance has been formally validated by environmental ministry decree covering the camp boundary and surrounding fragile permafrost buffer.
ENVR-ECOPERM-36O：For Llullaillaco Ridge Outpost, environmental impact clearance has not been granted under the environmental ministry decree covering the camp boundary and surrounding fragile permafrost buffer.
ENVR-ECOPERM-SVW：For Ojos del Salado Camp, environmental impact clearance has been formally validated by environmental ministry decree covering the camp boundary and surrounding fragile permafrost buffer.

information_points.title: Greywater mitigation（WASTE）
information_points.content:
ENVR-WASTE-IC9：According to the closed-loop filtration audit of camp greywater processing facilities over 30 days, Atacama Plateau Base demonstrated a greywater recycling efficiency of 85%.
ENVR-WASTE-GLN：According to the closed-loop filtration audit of camp greywater processing facilities over 30 days, Llullaillaco Ridge Outpost demonstrated a greywater recycling efficiency of 95%.
ENVR-WASTE-ZRB：According to the closed-loop filtration audit of camp greywater processing facilities over 30 days, Ojos del Salado Camp demonstrated a greywater recycling efficiency of 70%.
